Parte 3: Itens e Acessibilidade

Maxwell diz: "Bem, meu aprendiz dedicado, you have made it this far, and so you are deserving of the explanation for the asterisk on the very first page of this manual. The bitter truth is, try and we might, we cannot Teste de Resistência them all. We cannot fix every injury, every illness, every ill. I lied, and I hope you will forgive me. Nothing is guaranteed.

"Sometimes a Cirurgia is unsuccessful despite your best efforts, and you need to resort to other options. There are all manner of equipments out there that can help get your patient back on their pés, swinging dragons, slaying swords, and whatnot. No pupil of mine is going get a complete education sem knowing about all of them."

 

Uma observação sobre próteses

Pode ser difícil acostumar-se a usar um membro protético depois de a new injury. Some prosthetics take weeks of practice antes de they begin to feel natural. Como Dungeon Master, você pode decidir to not to give your players some of the mechanical benefits of wearing a prosthetic right away to reflect this.
